BiblicalUsage: Astonishment of heart is one of the curses Moses warns of in Deuteronomy 28:28, and Zechariah says the Lord will smite every horse with astonishment in the day He opens His eyes upon the house of Judah. The word is a stunned, dazed confusion that God sends.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word shows judgment striking the mind itself: not only the body or the land, but the heart's ability to think clearly.
